brand.tagline: 把复杂信息，组织成清晰画面
brand.concept: 多层信息并置后仍各自清晰

cyan.role: outer beams 1 and 3 (colour icon); echo tint
cyan.usage: symbol-color beams 1/3, brand-banner mark and echo, launch-poster mark

amber.usage: symbol-color beam 2, kicker rule, OPEN BETA pill, poster top band, echo tint

black.usage: symbol-black only; verified RGB=0,0,0 on every non-transparent pixel

ink_navy.usage: brand-banner, launch-poster canvas and body colour; text on the amber pill

transparent.usage: both 512x512 icons; Snapshot background is fully transparent (alpha 0)

echo_alpha.role: 10% alpha variants of cyan and amber
echo_alpha.usage: background echo of the mark in brand-banner only

proportions.corner_radius_rule: corner_radius = thickness / 2, so every beam is a true capsule
proportions.beam_axis: the 45 degree forward-slash diagonal (perpendicular to the centre line)
proportions.rotation_origin: (128,44) = half length, half thickness = beam centre
proportions.nesting_rule: Positioned > Transform > Container, inside a Stack

measured_geometry.source: brand-audit.json, measured from the rendered 512px PNG

minimum_clear_space.rule: keep at least 66 px (0.75 x beam thickness) of empty margin on all four sides; never place type, rules or edges inside it
minimum_clear_space.scales_with_mark: when the mark is scaled by k, clear space scales by k as well (banner k=0.34375 -> 22.7 px, poster k=0.703125 -> 46.4 px)

small_size.legibility_target: recognisable at 32 x 32 by silhouette and key negative space
improvements_applied: channel widened 28 -> 34 px, so at 32 px it goes from 1.75 px to 2.1 px of nominal gap
beam thickened 84 -> 88 px, so each stroke keeps ~5.5 px at 32 px
corner radius locked to half the thickness so the capsule ends never square off under downsampling
clear space raised to 12.89% so the silhouette never crowds the frame

symbol-black.purity: every pixel with alpha > 0 has RGB = 0,0,0; antialiasing is expressed only through alpha (min alpha 1, ink pixels 63679)
symbol-black.geometry_identity: identical to symbol-color: solid coverage (alpha > 128) differs on 0 pixels; the remaining 872 fringe pixels differ by at most 1 alpha level of premultiplied rounding

families.sans: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP

typography.font_provenance: fonts listed by the service /fonts endpoint (shared request shared-fonts-0001); both CJK families are present there

brand-banner.composition: horizontal: kicker rule, mark at left, vertical hairline divider, wordmark and tagline to the right, 10% alpha echo of the mark at far right

mark.generated_by: Get-Bars 176 96 112 (same DSL rule set, re-emitted at scale)

echo.role: decorative repeat of the same geometry, drawn behind the copy
echo.generated_by: Get-Bars 300 872 48 with 1A alpha suffix on both hues

required_copy: 把复杂信息，组织成清晰画面

launch-poster.composition: vertical and centred, deliberately unlike the banner: top band, large mark, wordmark, tagline, badge, date, divider, URL

mark.generated_by: Get-Bars 360 360 144 (same DSL rule set, re-emitted at scale)

required_copy: 把复杂信息，组织成清晰画面

vertical_balance.note: shifted up 24 px after viewing render-02 so the bottom margin exceeds the top margin (optical balance)

shared_generation_rule.single_source_of_geometry: Get-Bars(box, ox, oy, cA, cB, cC) is the only place the mark is defined; it scales k = box/512 and emits the same three Position/Transform/Container beams
shared_generation_rule.no_embedded_raster: the banner and poster contain zero Image/base64/URL tokens; the mark is regenerated from the same geometric rules at every scale, not pasted from the rendered icon
shared_generation_rule.determinism: re-running gen.ps1 reproduces byte-identical DSL for unchanged artefacts (verified: only launch-poster changed between render rounds 02 and 03)
